name: MS. AFRA IRSHAD
subject: ACCOUNTING TUTOR
qualifications: **ACCA Finalist** | Professional Level, Outstanding **Cambridge Learner Award for Cambridge A-Levels (3A*s).**
message:
Afra brings a strong academic background and a passion for teaching to the classroom. An ACCA Finalist and a BSc (Hons) in Applied Accounting graduate from Oxford Brookes University, she has also earned the Outstanding Cambridge Learner Award for Cambridge A-Levels (3A*s).

With **3 years of teaching experience** and a 100% pass rate, she understands student challenges and focuses on clear, exam-focused guidance.

At **CAMDEX Education**, Ms. Afra teaches Accounting for **Edexcel** and **Cambridge O/Level** students, helping them build confidence and achieve strong results.

name: MR. DEVIN SENATILLEKE
subject: MATHEMATICS TUTOR
message:
With more than **6 years of experience** teaching **IGCSE Mathematics under both Edexcel and Cambridge curricula**, Mr. Devin Senatilleke has consistently guided students toward exceptional outcomes.

Recognized for his engaging and approachable teaching style, he focuses on strengthening core mathematical skills while fostering logical reasoning and confidence in problem-solving.

At CAMDEX Education, he instructs Mathematics from **Grade 7 to O/Levels**, encouraging students to excel academically while cultivating a deep comprehension and lasting enthusiasm for the subject.

name: MR. DIMITRI COORAY
subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE TUTOR
qualifications: CertTEFL – Lanka TEFL Training Institute, MA in Teaching English as a Second Language – MA in Teaching English as a Second Language (in reading), Open University of Sri Lanka, Diploma in Speech & Drama – London College of Music
message:
With **over 8 years of teaching experience in English Language, Literature in English, and IELTS**, he has also served in leadership roles as **Sectional Head – O/Level and Subject Head – Literature in English** at a prominent international school in Colombo.

Renowned for his **student-centered approach**, Dimitri sir has a proven track record of fostering **academic excellence, critical thinking, and personal growth** in learners.

At **CAMDEX Education**, he teaches **Cambridge and Edexcel English** from **Grade 7 to O/Levels**, inspiring students to excel in their academics and develop a lifelong love for the English language.

name: MS. HAANI NIHAL
subject: ECONOMICS TUTOR
qualifications: BBA specializing in Business Economics - University of Colombo (Reading), **CIMA Passed Finalist.**
message:
With a strong academic background and a passion for teaching, she is committed to helping students build a clear understanding of Economics while achieving excellent academic results. Her approach focuses on developing strong conceptual knowledge, analytical thinking, and confidence in applying economic concepts to real-world situations.

She is currently pursuing her studies at the **University of Colombo** and is a CIMA passed finalist, bringing a solid foundation in business, finance, and economics to her teaching.

At CAMDEX Education, she teaches **Cambridge and Edexcel Economics for O/Level students**, supporting them in achieving academic success while developing a practical understanding of the world of economics.

name: MR. PRASANNA SANJEEWA
subject: BUSINESS TUTOR
qualifications: Bachelor of Business Administration (Special) - University of Colombo
message:
He brings **7 years of experience** as an **IGCSE** and **IAL** educator, during which he has consistently helped students achieve impressive academic results. Known for his commitment to student success, he has earned a strong reputation for nurturing high achievers and fostering deep, lasting subject understanding.

His teaching journey includes Edexcel and Cambridge commerce-stream subjects in **several reputed international schools in Colombo**, where he has effectively guided learners through challenging syllabuses and supported them in reaching their academic goals.

At CAMDEX Education, he teaches Business for O-Level students, empowering them with solid theoretical knowledge, practical insight, and the confidence to excel in the world of business.

name: MR. QAIDH SINNALEBBE
subject: ICT TUTOR
qualifications:
BA in Creative Multimedia (Reading),
HND in Advertising and Graphic Design
message:
With more than **4 years of experience** in the field of education, Mr. Qaidh is committed to cultivating creativity, innovation, and real-world problem-solving in his classroom.

Blending his technical expertise with a passion for teaching, he creates interactive learning experiences that empower students to think critically and apply their knowledge effectively.

At CAMDEX Education, he teaches **ICT from Grade 7 to O/Levels**, guiding students to master essential digital skills while preparing them to thrive in an increasingly technology-driven world.

name: MR. SHEHAN MORAGODA
subject: BIOLOGY, PHYSICS & CHEMISTRY TUTOR
qualifications:
B.Sc. Biomedical Science accredited by MSU Malaysia,
Dip. in Psychology from Cardiff Metropolitan
message:
With over **8 years of experience** teaching **IGCSE and IAL Science across both Edexcel and Cambridge programs**, Shehan sir has empowered students to achieve remarkable results and build strong scientific skills.

Passionate about bringing science to life, he transforms complex topics into accessible, thought-provoking lessons that spark curiosity and inspire exploration.

At CAMDEX Education, he teaches **Biology, Chemistry, and Physics from Grade 7 to O/Levels**, encouraging students to excel academically while nurturing a genuine enthusiasm and confidence in the world of science.

name: MR. YUSUF SHIHAM
subject: COMPUTER SCIENCE TUTOR
qualifications:
Undergraduate- BSc. Hons Information Technology
specializing in Artificial Intelligence(Reading)
message:
Currently pursuing a **degree in Artificial Intelligence at the Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology**, Mr. Yusuf brings together academic excellence and a deep enthusiasm for teaching.

He is dedicated to fostering an engaging and intellectually enriching learning atmosphere, where students not only gain confidence in Computer Science but also strengthen their analytical and problem-solving abilities.

At CAMDEX Education, he teaches **Computer Science for Edexcel and Cambridge O/Level** students, equipping them with the knowledge, skills, and mindset needed to excel academically and thrive in an increasingly digital future.
